tools.name: vucar_how_selling_works
tools.description: Explains the Vucar process (submit, free inspection, dealers bid in an auction, owner decides), the fees (no listing fee; 1-2% service fee only after a successful sale, rate confirmed before closing) and contact details (hotline 1800 646 896, vucar.vn). Static information, no side effects. / Giải th

tools.name: vucar_car_catalog
tools.description: Lists the car catalog Vucar uses for valuation. With no input it lists brands; with brand it lists models; with brand+model it lists years; with brand+model+year it lists variants. Use it to map the owner's free text to exact names before vucar_estimate_price. Lists are capped. Read-only. / Tra cứu

tools.name: vucar_estimate_price
tools.description: Returns an indicative price range in VND for a used car in Vietnam, rounded to the nearest 5,000,000 VND. It is not an offer: the final price comes from Vucar's inspection and dealer bidding. Use exact names from vucar_car_catalog. Rate limited. Read-only. / Ước tính khoảng giá tham khảo (VND); giá

tools.name: vucar_sell_send_otp
tools.description: Step 1 of submitting a car. Sends a 5-digit code to the owner's phone via Zalo; it expires in 2 minutes. Ask the OWNER to read the code to you and pass it to vucar_sell_car. Never guess or invent a code. Only call this with the owner's consent. Rate limited. / Gửi mã OTP 5 số tới điện thoại chủ xe q

tools.name: vucar_sell_car
tools.description: Step 2 of submitting a car. Creates a real sell request for a Vucar specialist to follow up (they call the owner to book a free inspection; the owner is not obliged to sell).
